dependent or zero-payload records, callbacks and owned positions remain
separate work.

[Nested checked-record Java/Kotlin packages](../evidence/nested-checked-record-jvm-20261016/index.json) establish those positions through generated Java records and Kotlin classes in reproduced, source-free and relocated Maven installations on JDK 22.0.2 and Kotlin 2.2.0. The tested Packet carries Fin 10 and checked Nat Subtype fields; every selected constructor, exact rejection path, caller snapshot and recovery is checked. [Nested checked-record Perl packages](../evidence/nested-checked-record-perl-20261016/index.json) establish the same copied positions through generated blessed Packet, Holder and Choice::Packet classes on both author routes and API modes. Two author roots reproduce complete CPAN component and runtime archives before source-free offline installation on threaded and unthreaded Perl 5.36.3 and 5.38.2 in prebuilt-only and build-XS modes. Unchanged callers run before and after moving each installation on Linux x64/glibc 2.36; exact constructor failures preserve caller graphs and later calls recover. [Nested checked-record native PHP packages](../evidence/nested-checked-record-php-20261016/index.json) establish the same copied positions through generated final readonly Packet, Holder and ChoicePacket classes on both author routes and API modes. Two author roots reproduce complete Composer ZIPs before author and build removal and offline installation; unchanged weak and strict callers run before and after moving each installation on PHP 8.2.33 and Composer 2.5.5 with Linux x64/glibc 2.36. Exact constructor failures preserve caller graphs and later calls recover; consumer PHP source remains required at runtime. [Nested checked-record Python wheels](../evidence/nested-checked-record-python-20261016/index.json) establish the same copied positions through generated frozen Packet, Holder and ChoicePacket dataclasses on both author routes and API modes. Two author roots reproduce one complete wheel for both CPython floors before author removal and offline installation; the unchanged caller runs on CPython 3.11.16 and 3.12.14 before and after moving each installation on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. Exact constructor failures preserve caller graphs and later calls recover. [PHP-Wasm checked-record packages](../evidence/checked-record-php-wasm-promotion-20261011.md) pass the earlier top-level forms in all four routes through weak/strict Node/Chromium callers on wasm32 PHP 8.4.1.
